name: harness-tier
description: harness-tier risk-tiered workflow + Teams notification harness

interface.longDescription: harness-tier scales process rigor to the risk of a change. $flow classifies a task as Docs or Dev and runs only that tier's skills, and a commit gate that $flow-init registers in the project's .codex/hooks.json blocks a commit that skipped the classification or its gates. Branch names, test commands and checks live in one config file, so the same setup ports to any language and repository.
defaultPrompt: Set up harness-tier in this repo with $flow-init
Classify this change and run its tier with $flow
